verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama running a range of models: Gemma 4 via `ollama run`, an MoE model (qwen3.5:35b-a3b) benchmarked hands-on, multimodal chat that a user says "works as expected", one-command pulls from Hugging Face or the Ollama registry, and local image generation on macOS. It does not show the breadth the story claims. Missing for 10: any evidence of embedding-model support, any documented claim or catalog showing hundreds of distinct architectures, and first-party docs on supported architecture types.
